snippet.title: Shard Squad – Free Update Teaser
snippet.description:
Assemble a squad of elemental creatures and face hordes of challenging enemies! Choose your Shards based on their synergies to unlock new abilities, and equip relics that will turn the winds in your favor! Survive different scenarios and save your homeland!

Play Shard Squad now!
